## [1.6.0](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-09-28)

### ✨ New Features

* add F1 update dismissal and Movie Paradise GMS support ([4cf9ea5](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/4cf9ea5d381dee980fd0649455889b3f590262a3))

patches.name: F1 TV - Background playback
patches.description: Keeps Bitmovin playback alive and enables Tiledmedia background audio for F1 TV multiview.

patches.name: F1 TV - Change package name
patches.description: Changes the F1 TV package name to allow installing a separate patched instance. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name.

options.description: Package name to use for the cloned F1 TV app.
Update custom permissions declared by F1 TV. This can fix installation conflicts, but may break app features.
Update provider names declared by F1 TV. This can fix installation conflicts, but may break app features.

patches.name: F1 TV - Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates for the F1 TV package by setting its version code to the maximum allowed.

patches.name: F1 TV - Dismiss forced update prompt
patches.description: Allows closing F1 TV's forced-update dialog without exiting the app.

patches.name: F1 TV - Foreground playback service
patches.description: Keeps background F1 TV playback alive with an Android media playback notification and playback/PiP controls.

patches.name: F1 TV - Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Keeps F1 TV playback alive while entering Android Picture-in-Picture mode.

patches.name: Movie Paradise - GmsCore support (microG login)
patches.description: Routes Google Play Services through microG (MicroG-RE) so Google sign-in works without stock Play Services.

patches.name: Movie Paradise - PairIP license bypass
patches.description: Neutralises Google Play integrity/license checks (PairIP) so a repackaged build launches.
